summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by BioNTech SE announcing a press release about its upcoming presentations of new clinical data and trial updates from its late-stage oncology pipeline at the 2026 ASCO Annual Meeting. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change is disclosed. The filing is a routine current report on the progress of clinical trials and is not a special situation.
